title: The exact number that buys your freedom

beats.say: You're trapped in the rat race because your paycheck stops the second you stop working.
beats.visual: Cinematic shot of a busy downtown sidewalk at dusk, motion blurred feet, low angle.

beats.say: Here's the math that sets you free, using the 4% rule from the 1998 Trinity study.
beats.visual: A vintage calculator on a dark wooden desk, soft window light, shallow depth of field.

beats.say: To replace $2,000 of monthly expenses with passive income, you need about $600,000 invested.
beats.visual: Close up of a stack of old leather bound books on a minimalist table.

beats.say: That sounds impossible until you look at how time and compounding work for you.
beats.visual: A single brass pendulum swinging steadily in front of a dark concrete wall.

beats.say: Investing $500 a month at 8% a year reaches that $600,000 target in 27.6 years.
beats.visual: A ceramic cup of black coffee casting a long shadow on a concrete countertop.

beats.say: Up that to $1,000 a month, and you hit it in 20.2 years.
beats.visual: An empty wooden chair by a large window with morning fog outside.

beats.say: But here's the catch nobody mentions. Passive income takes serious capital or years of discipline.
beats.visual: A sleek modern desk with a blank notepad and a fountain pen, side view.

beats.say: Real estate has vacancies, and stocks drop when you least expect them.
beats.visual: Raindrops sliding down a tall glass window overlooking a quiet city street.

beats.say: That's why you build assets that pay you every month instead of buying liabilities.
beats.visual: A person's hands locking a heavy wooden door from the inside.

beats.say: Calculate your exact monthly survival number today, and start funding the gap.
beats.visual: A minimalist metal lamp illuminating a clean desk at night.

beats.say: Follow for the money rules school never taught you, because that's exactly how...
beats.visual: A dark hallway with a single warm light at the far end, centered symmetry.

caption:
The rat race ends when your passive income covers your life. Here is the exact math.

#ratrace #passiveincome #personalfinance #investing #moneytok
